title: Google threat intelligence group details how one of its researchers infiltrated hacker group TeamPCP and helped disrupt its software supply chain hacking spree (Andy Greenberg/Wired)
summary: Andy Greenberg / Wired: Google threat intelligence group details how one of its researchers infiltrated hacker group TeamPCP and helped disrupt its software supply chain hacking spree — TeamPCP pulled off the worst-ever software supply-chain hacking spree and breached thousands of companies.
